response.rationale: Tier B with 23 orders in 28 days is a moderate-evidence cell, and the shrunk dROAS reduces noise, so the efficiency read is reasonably trustworthy. However, shrunk realised dROAS (1.975) sits ~11% below the goal (2.22), meaning this cell is already under-delivering on efficiency — a +10% raise pushes spend further into under-performance. The CLEARS verdict indicates the raise passes mechanical guardrails, so I don't cut deeply, but I dampen the raise to ~75% of its size to respect the goal shortfall. Confidence is moderate: the below-goal signal is clear, but tier B evidence and the shrinking leave room for the mechanical model to know something I don't.
